d:
Two separate firing incidents were reported in Delhi. In Yamuna Khadar, accused Aman Gurjar was injured in an exchange of fire with the Delhi Police near New Usmanpur. Police are probing his alleged links with gangster Naseem Durrani and the D-Company. In another incident in Lahori Gate, a student was injured after a shot was fired during a scuffle between youths. Police are investigating both cases.
